storage.description: Choose where your conversation history is stored.

context.title: Context Settings
context.description: Configure how context is assembled and compressed.
context.tokenHelp: Higher values provide more context but increase latency and cost.
context.compressionDescription: Use AI to intelligently compress context
context.compressionRemoteHelp: Uses a fast cloud model for compression. Summaries are sent to server.
context.compressionLocalHelp: Uses a local model for compression. Everything stays on your machine.
context.allowGitignoredDescription: Include files matched by .gitignore in context
context.gitignoredEnabledHelp: Gitignored files (e.g., build outputs, secrets) will be accessible to the AI.
context.gitignoredDisabledHelp: Gitignored files are hidden from the AI for security and relevance.
context.warmupPrefetchDescription: Send the active editor file and repo instructions during model warmup
context.warmupPrefetchEnabledHelp: Supported providers can prewarm their prompt cache with your active file and AGENTS.md, reducing first-response latency and repeated prompt cost.
context.warmupPrefetchDisabledHelp: Warmup only opens the provider connection. The AI reads editor state and files on demand instead.
